_rule: Each test starts from public accessions only and runs committed code; 'compare' names what must equal the committed result. Edit here; reproduce/README.md is generated from this file by reproduce/readme.py.

tests.title: Met-A's reference, rebuilt from public arrays: noise sites and gate, the floor, the 6,000 identity sites, the healthy spread and the blood-composition markers
tests.shows: Every reference matrix Met-A reads is rebuilt from 91 public purified-blood arrays and comes out identical to the frozen file the chain reads.

must_contain: same set True \| only here 0 \| only committed 0
sites same: True \| refs same: True
H_mean max diff 0\.0e\+00 \| H_sd_shrunk max diff 0\.0e\+00

tests.title: Blood-cell shares in 200 mixtures from a laboratory the atlas never saw (E-MTAB-2145)
tests.shows: The Deconvolver reads 200 mixtures of purified cells from an unseen laboratory within 0.016 of the true shares, and its sample check refuses the arrays that do not read as their own cell.

tests.title: The C-Score's healthy range holds in a laboratory that did not set it (GSE184269)
tests.shows: Healthy whole bloods from a second laboratory read inside the C-Score band: 22 of 23 not above 1.152, the bar sealed before the arrays were fetched.

tests.title: IAM-A's self-reference line, rebuilt from 158 public healthy-cell sequencing files
tests.shows: Every healthy cell type's held error falls on one simple line; recounted from GEO and ENCODE files through chain Stage Q2, every count, the line and the sample-shape reference come out identical.
public_inputs: ENCODE ENCFF092SBB, ENCFF605NRU, ENCFF133QNK, ENCFF704SCQ, ENCFF969NGH

tests.title: The same DNA gives the same reading in three laboratories (SEQC2 EpiQC, GSE230132)
tests.shows: Identical cell-line DNA run at three laboratories: Met-A's technical repeats agree within 0.0114 and the same DNA across laboratories within 0.0084.

must_contain: BARS 1 A repeat <= 0\.012: 1\.00 \| 2 A_rel across labs <= 0\.02: 1\.00 \| 3 C repeat <= 0\.10: 0\.90 \| 4 C_rel across labs <= 0\.10: 1\.00

tests.title: Physics called it in advance, in living mice (GSE77079)
tests.shows: Mice that cannot make enough of the methyl donor hold their marks worse, by the amount the law predicted before the data were read: knockout over wild type 1.124, inside the sealed window 1.016 to 1.135 (p 0.0003).
tests.time: about 10 h on 16 cores (mm10 index 100 min, then 38 runs at about 12 min each)

must_contain: KO vehicle / WT ratio 1\.1[0-3]\d\d \(window 1\.016-1\.135\) \| p \(KO > WT\) 0\.000\d \| -> PASS

tests.tolerance_note: The aligner (bwa-meth, on bwa mem) can place a few reads differently with a different thread count, so per-run error rates are compared within 0.0005 and the verdict must be PASS with the ratio 1.10 to 1.139; the committed run gives 1.1238.
tests.memory: 64 GB (bwa mem on the converted mm10 index with 16 threads is killed at 32 GB)

tests.instrument: Met-A on tissue, with IAM-Atlas v2
tests.title: Colorectal tumors leave their own healthy tissue's range (GSE131013, 88 patients)
tests.shows: Each tumor read against the same patient's adjacent normal tissue at the atlas's composition-blind sites: 28 of 88 pairs above the bar fixed on normal pairs alone (11 needed), the sealed fingerprint verdict.

tests.instrument: Met-A on tissue, with IAM-Atlas v2
tests.title: Breast cancer: tumors leave the patient's own healthy range far more often than chance
tests.shows: Each tumor read against the same patient's healthy tissue at the atlas's composition-blind sites: 23 of 53 pairs above the bar fixed on normal pairs alone (about 3 expected by chance), the sealed fingerprint verdict.

tests.instrument: Met-A on tissue, with IAM-Atlas v2
tests.title: Liver cancer: a third cancer, the same result
tests.shows: Each tumor read against the same patient's healthy tissue at the atlas's composition-blind sites: 22 of 50 pairs above the bar fixed on normal pairs alone (about 2 expected by chance), the sealed fingerprint verdict.
